_preregistration.why_z: Delta is defined as a contrast against a matched shuffle, so comparing it to a raw gzip length would rig the test; and the shuffle ensemble's finite-sample bias cancels, which is what makes C_mu and excess entropy usable at 440 words
_preregistration.length_control: every regime truncated to the same word budget, so length is held constant by construction rather than partialled out -- the InChI-length confound (r=0.95) cannot operate
_preregistration.primary: does any baseline reproduce Delta's ordering across the reference regimes? Spearman on the CONTRAST (value - shuffle mean); |rho| >= 0.9 for a compression or entropy baseline means the ensemble construction is a redescription and #20 should stop
_preregistration.primary_was_corrected: The first version ranked on the z-score rather than the contrast, and its own pre-registered KILL CONDITION fired: Delta appeared to peak on degenerate_x2. The cause was the normalisation, not Delta. z = contrast/sd explodes when the CONTROL has little variance -- shuffling a 2-cycle barely changes it, so sd = 0.0153 turned a contrast of +0.34 into z = 22.2, above real text's +6.87 at z = 3.2 -- and z is UNDEFINED when the control has no variance at all, which silently dropped degenerate_x1 and unique_tokens, two of the cleanest poles. Delta is DEFINED as a contrast (§3.4), so ranking on its z-score was ranking something that is not Delta. The contrast is the primary; z is kept as a separate detection statistic, which is the one question it does answer well.
_preregistration.secondary: which regime does each measure rank highest? a disorder measure peaks on random soup; Delta must peak on real text. A difference in SHAPE, which no correlation coefficient explains away
_preregistration.sharpest: C_mu and excess entropy are established one-hump measures that already peak at criticality (Lindgren & Nordahl 1988; Crutchfield). If Delta peaks where they peak, #20 is one paragraph
_preregistration.ca_cells: measured but EXCLUDED from every verdict -- one settle run each (F57)

analysis.statistic: contrast (value - shuffle mean); z kept as a separate detection statistic only

verdict: Delta peaks on REAL TEXT, as it must, at +6.87 against +0.34 for degenerate repetition and +0.00 for noise. NO BASELINE REPRODUCES IT: the closest is repair_size at rho=-0.88, inside the +/-0.9 threshold. AND THE DIFFERENCE IS IN SHAPE, not in strength: of 12 baselines, NONE peaks on real text -- 11 of them peak on 'degenerate_x2'. Every compression and entropy measure responds MORE STRONGLY to degenerate repetition than to real English, and Delta is the only one that inverts that, by a factor of 20. That is §3.3's result -- the exponential weighting is what keeps real text on top -- now shown against the full baseline suite rather than against three tempered versions of itself. A difference in shape is not explainable by a correlation coefficient. On the sharpest objection (Lindgren & Nordahl 1988; Crutchfield): C_mu peaks on random_soup, excess_entropy peaks on degenerate_x2. Neither peaks on real text here, so Delta is not a redescription of statistical complexity AS ESTIMATED AT THIS LENGTH -- which is a statement about a coarse, undersampled estimator on 440 words, NOT about C_mu itself. A proper CSSR reconstruction could still peak with Delta and this experiment could not tell. SEPARATELY, AND CONCEDING SOMETHING §3.2 OVERSTATED: against a 20-shuffle ensemble rather than the single shuffle §3.2 used, 5 measures DO detect word order on real text at |z| >= 3 -- strongest gzip_bits at z=-8.1. So "every compression baseline is null under multiset control" is wrong: they are not blind to word order, they are merely ordered differently across regimes. The case for the ensemble quantity rests on the ORDERING, not on compression being unable to see word order. n_words, n_types, H0 are EXACTLY INVARIANT under the control (contrast 0 in every regime) and are excluded from the peak test rather than counted as peaking anywhere. That is provable, not measured: a word shuffle permutes the multiset and all three are functions of the multiset alone -- which is precisely why the InChI-length confound cannot operate in this design. The 28 CA cells are measured and stored but excluded from this verdict: one settle run each, and Delta is a tail statistic (F57).
